quarterly_data.signal: Honeywell 10-K: many major components, product equipment items and raw materials, particularly in Aerospace Technologies, are procured or subcontracted on a single or sole-source basis; sales are not materially dependent on a single customer or a small group of customers; 2025 sales to the U.S. Department of Defense were $4,209 million (total U.S. government $4,752 million); total research and development costs $2,886 million ($1,812 million company funded, $1,074 million customer-sponsored). Portfolio moves: Sundyne (highly engineered pumps and gas compressors for process industries) acquired June 6, 2025; Air Products' liquefied natural gas process technology and equipment business acquired September 30, 2024; CAES (high-reliability radio frequency technologies) acquired August 30, 2024; Carrier's Global Access Solutions acquired June 3, 2024; an agreement to acquire Johnson Matthey's Catalyst Technologies segment; the PPE business sold May 21, 2025; Advanced Materials spun off as Solstice Advanced Materials on October 30, 2025.
